tongatapu-21.bio: Coral limestone trilithon at Niutōua, said to have been raised by a king for his two sons.
tongatapu-21.notes: No fee found; Wikivoyage lists hours 09:00-18:00 but no price, so free is unconfirmed. Century omitted (sources conflict).

tongatapu-22.bio: Terraced langi tombs of the Tuʻi Tonga kings at Lapaha in Muʻa, for centuries the Tongan capital.

tongatapu-23.bio: Tonga's largest city, on Tongatapu's north coast, with a waterfront Royal Palace and most of the lodging.
tongatapu-23.notes: Town, open access. Category historic is the owner's call.

tongatapu-24.bio: A natural land bridge on Tongatapu's south-eastern coast, among the island's most beautiful sights.

tongatapu-25.bio: Blowholes in the coral reef at Houma on the south-west coast, known as the Whistle of the Noble.
tongatapu-25.notes: Free per Wikivoyage. Best-at-high-tide claim unverified, left out of bio.

tongatapu-26.bio: Cave about 400 m long near Haveluliku, with freshwater pools up to 8 m deep and a beach near the entrance.
tongatapu-26.notes: TOP 20 per person from Wikivoyage only; operator publishes no price: unverified. Site loaded (title 'ʻAnahulu cave').

tongatapu-27.bio: Nukuʻalofa's daily market, with fresh tropical produce downstairs and Tongan handicrafts upstairs.
tongatapu-27.notes: No entry fee found; 'daily' is Wikivoyage's reading. No official site.

tongatapu-28.bio: Small island a 10-minute boat ride from Nukuʻalofa, with beaches, a restaurant and snorkel gear to hire.
tongatapu-28.notes: Island day-access fee not found (unconfirmed). Boat fare (about TOP 20 return) is transport, not the price. Wreck left out (transient).

tongatapu-29.bio: Colony of Pacific flying foxes, a fruit bat, in the western village of Kolovai.
tongatapu-29.notes: No fee found; bats roost along the village road. Pin still unresolved (no coordinates).

tongatapu-30.bio: Tongatapu beach known for coral formations, snorkelling and swimming, popular at sunset.

eua-island-1.bio: Tonga's only forest national park, a band of rainforest on ʻEua's east coast edged by cliffs and caves.
eua-island-1.notes: No fee found in any source; Forestry Division not reached, so free is unconfirmed. No Tongan park pass exists.

eua-island-2.bio: Rock formations on 200 m clifftops, with horses grazing between them and seabirds gliding past.
eua-island-2.notes: Listed as free by a guide; the route passes a farm gate with no fee.

eua-island-3.bio: Cliffs at ʻEua's far southern tip with nesting seabirds, reached past Haʻaluma Beach and the Rock Gardens.
eua-island-3.notes: Thin evidence and overlaps the Rock Gardens; visit hours are a default. Free per a guide.

eua-island-4.bio: A giant ovava (banyan) in ʻEua's rainforest, said to be over 800 years old, reached by a short bush walk.
eua-island-4.notes: Trail starts near Hafu Pool by a 1.8 km dirt road, high clearance advised. Free per a guide.

eua-island-5.bio: A large natural stone bridge by the sea on ʻEua, named for the legendary Maui, reached by a short walk.
eua-island-5.notes: Free per a guide. Maui link: name only, legend itself not sourced.

eua-island-6.bio: Long white beach on ʻEua's south coast, with large tidal pools for snorkelling and swimming.
eua-island-6.notes: Free per a guide. Visit hours are an estimate.

eua-island-7.bio: Near-sea-level coral reef shore between ʻOhonua and Tufuvai, dotted with many small tidal pools.
eua-island-7.notes: No gate found; free not independently confirmed. Pin unresolved.

vavau-1.bio: Tonga's second-largest town, on the Port of Refuge harbour, a base for sailing, whale tours and islands.

vavau-2.bio: Sea cave entered through an underwater tunnel, reached by boat on day trips from Neiafu.
vavau-2.notes: About 50 per person is a shared day-boat trip also covering Swallows Cave; currency not stated by the source, TOP assumed. Approximate. Sold by many operators, no ticketUrl.

vavau-3.bio: Sea cave reached by boat from Neiafu on day trips, known as an excellent place to snorkel.
vavau-3.notes: Same shared day-trip price as Mariners Cave; currency assumed TOP; approximate. No ticketUrl (many operators).

vavau-4.bio: Island 35 minutes by boat from Neiafu, with sheltered bays where humpback whales gather with calves.
vavau-4.notes: No island fee found; boat trip price is transport. Whales are seasonal (about Jun-Nov): put timing in the destination text.

vavau-5.bio: Vavaʻu's second-largest island, a short boat ride from Neiafu, with beaches and snorkelling.
vavau-5.notes: No fee found; open access is a default, not positively sourced.

vavau-6.bio: National park near Neiafu with a steep 1 km trail to a lookout, about 10 to 20 minutes up.
vavau-6.notes: Listed as free by a guide; no agency site found.

vavau-7.bio: A botanical garden on Vavaʻu's east coast with Tonga's largest plant collection, visited by guided tour.
vavau-7.notes: NZD 110 per person is a third-party booker's price for the 1.5 h guided tour: LOW confidence. No official site found (email only); ticketUrl null.

tofua.bio: Volcanic cone in western Haʻapai, reached by hired boat, with a steep one-hour climb to the crater.
tofua.notes: No landing fee found; boat hire is transport. Lava lake deliberately left out (transient). Pin unresolved.

uoleva.bio: Almost uninhabited sand-cay island in Lifuka district with clean, quiet beaches and five small resorts.
uoleva.notes: Listed as a free activity. How to reach it (boat) left out of bio as unconfirmed.

niuafoou.bio: Tonga's northernmost island, a volcanic ring around two crater lakes, with crater hikes and swimming.
niuafoou.notes: No fee found. Transport and guides are not the price. Pin unresolved.

vai-lahi.bio: Freshwater crater lake at the heart of Niuafoʻou, 23 m above sea level, with four islands inside.
vai-lahi.notes: No fee found. Size figures (4 km, 84 m) left out. Pin unresolved.

niuatoputapu.bio: Volcanic island with white beaches, a freshwater spring dip and a climb with views of Tafahi's cone.
niuatoputapu.notes: No fee found. Flight from Vavaʻu not in evidence, left out. Pin unresolved.

tafahi.bio: Tiny island with a perfect 656 m volcanic cone, reached by local boat, with a steep climb best done with a guide.
tafahi.notes: No fee found; boat ride price not given (transport). Bio may run near the 3-line limit. Pin unresolved.
